 Maharishi University of Information Technology (MUIT), inspired by the vision of Maharishi Mahesh Yogi Ji, is a leading private university in Uttar Pradesh with campuses in Lucknow and Noida. With a focus on career-oriented education, research, and holistic student development, MUIT prepares students for success in both national and global arenas.
